knobs.name: hookRule
knobs.what: s: the rule starts typing (HOOK type sheet)

knobs.name: hookQ
knobs.what: s: the question line starts typing

knobs.name: hookOut
knobs.what: s: the HOOK type sheet fades out

knobs.name: cps
knobs.what: characters per second of every typed line

knobs.name: arr0
knobs.what: s: first box drops onto the plan (CASE)

knobs.name: arr1
knobs.what: s: arrival ends; must stay before count.at 24.0

knobs.name: arrW
knobs.what: fraction of the arrival a single box takes to land

knobs.name: drop
knobs.what: world units a box falls from as it lands

knobs.name: lit0
knobs.what: s: survivors start lighting, bottom row first

knobs.name: lit1
knobs.what: s: every survivor lit; 711 LIVED appears

knobs.name: pinPool
knobs.what: s: pooled counts (316 OF 425 ...) appear

knobs.name: ratioDelay
knobs.what: s a count holds before its % appears (floor 1.5: counts before ratios)

knobs.name: poolOut
knobs.what: s: pooled labels and the readout fade before the split

knobs.name: move0
knobs.what: s: boxes leave the carpets for their class slabs

knobs.name: move1
knobs.what: s: last box lands in its slab

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: spread of departure times inside the move (0 = all at once)

knobs.name: lift
knobs.what: world units of the arc a box makes in flight

knobs.name: orderMix
knobs.what: departure order: 0 seeded, 1 class by class

knobs.name: tilt0
knobs.what: s: the plan starts tilting into 3D (the split is the only tilt)

knobs.name: tilt1
knobs.what: s: the tilt and the turn end

knobs.name: tagOut
knobs.what: s: the two tagged boxes lose their outline and trail

knobs.name: pinIn
knobs.what: s: first slab pin enters (highest priority first)

knobs.name: pinStep
knobs.what: s between slab pins entering, by priority

knobs.name: pinDimOp
knobs.what: opacity of the slab pins the callout is not on

knobs.name: co1
knobs.what: s: callout on first-class children

knobs.name: co2
knobs.what: s: hard cut to second-class children

knobs.name: co3
knobs.what: s: hard cut to third-class children

knobs.name: co4
knobs.what: s: hard cut to first-class men

knobs.name: coOff
knobs.what: s: callout and pins leave for the reveal

knobs.name: co5
knobs.what: s: callout on the crew men (COUNT C)

knobs.name: coEnd
knobs.what: s: callout and crew pin leave (MONDAY)

knobs.name: deckT0
knobs.what: s: the camera starts dropping to deck level at the third-class children

knobs.name: deckDur
knobs.what: s: length of the drop

knobs.name: menT0
knobs.what: s: the camera pans along the deck to the first-class men

knobs.name: menDur
knobs.what: s: length of the pan

knobs.name: revT0
knobs.what: s: the camera pulls back to frame both slabs

knobs.name: revDur
knobs.what: s: length of the pull-back

knobs.name: mask0
knobs.what: s: everything but the lit 27 and the lit 57 starts dimming

knobs.name: maskDur
knobs.what: s: length of the dim in and out

knobs.name: mask2
knobs.what: s: the dim lifts for the crew

knobs.name: glow0
knobs.what: s: bloom and emission start on the counted group

knobs.name: glowUp
knobs.what: s: bloom ramp up

knobs.name: glow2
knobs.what: s: bloom starts ramping down

knobs.name: glowDown
knobs.what: s: bloom ramp down

knobs.name: res0
knobs.what: s: 34 % and 33 % appear over the two slabs

knobs.name: per10
knobs.what: s: 3 IN 10 appears over each

knobs.name: crewT0
knobs.what: s: the camera rises for the crew

knobs.name: crewDur
knobs.what: s: length of the rise

knobs.name: monT0
knobs.what: s: MONDAY: camera rises, exposure falls

knobs.name: monDur
knobs.what: s: length of the MONDAY rise

knobs.name: monQ
knobs.what: s: the Monday question starts typing

knobs.name: monHonest
knobs.what: s: the honest line appears

knobs.name: planAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the plan view

knobs.name: planEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the plan view (89 = straight down)

knobs.name: planZoom
knobs.what: ortho zoom of the plan (lower = closer)

knobs.name: planLookZ
knobs.what: world z the plan centres on (higher moves the carpets up)

knobs.name: hookDrift
knobs.what: degrees the plan drifts before the split

knobs.name: splitAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth after the turn (90 = square to the row)

knobs.name: splitEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation after the tilt

knobs.name: splitZoom
knobs.what: ortho zoom of the split view

knobs.name: splitLookY
knobs.what: world y the split view looks at (more negative moves the slabs down)

knobs.name: deckAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth at deck level

knobs.name: deckEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation at deck level

knobs.name: deckZoom
knobs.what: ortho zoom at deck level

knobs.name: deckLookY
knobs.what: world y the deck view looks at

knobs.name: revAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the reveal, crew and Monday

knobs.name: revEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the reveal

knobs.name: revZoom
knobs.what: ortho zoom of the reveal

knobs.name: revLookY
knobs.what: world y the reveal looks at

knobs.name: revMix
knobs.what: reveal centre between the first-class men (0) and the third-class children (1)

knobs.name: crewEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation for the crew

knobs.name: crewZoom
knobs.what: ortho zoom for the crew

knobs.name: monEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation in MONDAY

knobs.name: monZoom
knobs.what: ortho zoom in MONDAY

knobs.name: monLookY
knobs.what: world y MONDAY looks at

knobs.name: k
knobs.what: people per box: fixed at 1 by the claim perBox (read-only)

knobs.name: budget
knobs.what: box budget before LOD batching (>= 2,201 keeps 1 box = 1 person)

knobs.name: boxSize
knobs.what: edge of one box

knobs.name: boxGap
knobs.what: seam between boxes

knobs.name: poolCols
knobs.what: boxes across one pooled carpet (its rows follow from the count)

knobs.name: groupGap
knobs.what: air between the three carpets

knobs.name: layers
knobs.what: layers every split slab is normalised to (lit height = rate)

knobs.name: depth
knobs.what: boxes deep in a split slab (the view axis at deck level)

knobs.name: slabGap
knobs.what: air between classes in the row

knobs.name: pairGap
knobs.what: air between the groups of one class

knobs.name: deckPad
knobs.what: deck margin around both arrangements

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: how far a box of someone who did not live is mixed toward the ground

knobs.name: maskDim
knobs.what: how far everything outside the counted group dims in the reveal

knobs.name: keyAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth the hard key comes from (0 = screen left after the turn)

knobs.name: keyEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the key

knobs.name: keyGain
knobs.what: strength of the key (ambient + key = the brightest face)

knobs.name: ambGain
knobs.what: ambient light (lower = harder light)

knobs.name: rimGain
knobs.what: ember rim from the side opposite the key

knobs.name: gridOp
knobs.what: strength of the plan grid on the deck (0 = none)

knobs.name: gridStep
knobs.what: boxes between grid lines

knobs.name: deckTone
knobs.what: deck colour from ground (0) to panel (1)

knobs.name: postLevel
knobs.what: exec = tone map only; manager adds bloom, vignette, dof

knobs.name: bloomGain
knobs.what: bloom strength on the counted group

knobs.name: revealEmit
knobs.what: emission of the lit 27 and the lit 57 at the reveal (> 1 glows)

knobs.name: vignetteGain
knobs.what: corner darkening in the reveal and MONDAY

knobs.name: dofGain
knobs.what: depth of field in the reveal (0 = off; +0.5 s/frame)

knobs.name: dofFocus
knobs.what: focus distance from the eye, world units

knobs.name: grainGain
knobs.what: film grain in the reveal (engineer only)

knobs.name: chromaGain
knobs.what: chromatic split in the reveal (engineer only)

knobs.name: exposure
knobs.what: pre-tonemap exposure

knobs.name: monExposure
knobs.what: exposure multiplier in MONDAY

knobs.name: monGlow
knobs.what: faint glow the two revealed slabs keep in MONDAY

knobs.name: monMask
knobs.what: how far the rest stays dimmed in MONDAY

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before it hides

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: pin leader length, sheet units

knobs.name: maxShown
knobs.what: pin budget per frame

knobs.name: sticky
knobs.what: label hysteresis: window (bounded cost) or chain

knobs.name: calloutSize
knobs.what: callout count size (result face)

knobs.name: calloutLeader
knobs.what: callout leader length

knobs.name: plateOp
knobs.what: opacity of the ground-colour plate behind a pin

knobs.name: legendX
knobs.what: x of the colour legend (top right)

knobs.name: ruleSize
knobs.what: size of the rule in HOOK

knobs.name: ruleY
knobs.what: y of the rule

knobs.name: qSize
knobs.what: size of the HOOK question

knobs.name: monQSize
knobs.what: size of the Monday question

knobs.name: monY
knobs.what: y of the Monday question

knobs.name: countSize
knobs.what: size of the arrival counter

knobs.name: poolCount
knobs.what: size of the pooled counts and %

knobs.name: resultSize
knobs.what: size of 34 % and 33 % at the reveal
